name: Kisaragi Aoi
source:
The second daughter of the three Kisaragi sisters, a third-year student at a girls' school. Aoi seems to have inherited the blood of goddess Moegi, so they are very similar in appearance.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3378]Getchu[/url].]
